Name: Abrah's Catalogue
Author: AbrahMods
Description:
Abrah’s Furniture CatalogueA simple furniture catalogue for Stardew Valley 1.6. Buy the catalogue from Robin for 0g, place it anywhere, and right click to open a shop that lists Abrah’s custom furniture add-ons (download the item packs you like and they’ll appear inside the catalogue automatically).
[line]✨ What this is[list]
[*]Adds a catalogue furniture (“Abrah’s Catalogue”) you can place in your farmhouse or outdoors.
[*]Right-click the placed catalogue to open a shop-style menu
[*]The catalogue fills with whatever Abrah item packs you have installed (e.g., Enchanted Rose).
[/list][line]✅ Requirements[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+
[*][url=https://www.curseforge.com/stardewvalley/utility/smapi]SMAPI 4.0+[/url]
[*][url=https://www.curseforge.com/stardewvalley/mods/content-patcher]Content Patcher[/url] (Pathoschild.ContentPatcher)
[*][url=https://legacy.curseforge.com/linkout?remoteUrl=https%253a%252f%252fwww.nexusmods.com%252fstardewvalley%252fmods%252f20628%253ftab%253dfiles%2526file_id%253d82777]Calcifer[/url] (UniqueID: [code]leclair.calcifer[/code])
[/list][quote]Install the dependencies first, then this mod.[/quote][line]📥 How to download & install[list=1]
[*]Download this mod and extract it to:
[code]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\mods[/code]
[*]Extract the zip and put the folder only

[*](Optional) Download Abrah’s custom furniture packs. Each pack you add will show its items in the catalogue.

[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.

[/list][line]🛒 How to get the catalogue[list]
[*]Visit Robin (Carpenter’s Shop) and buy “Abrah’s Catalogue” for 0g.
[*]Place the catalogue where you like (indoors or outdoors).
[*]Right-click the placed catalogue to open the catalogue shop.
[/list][line] 
ℹ️ Notes[list]
[*]The catalogue itself is free at Robin so you can get started quickly.
[*]You can place the catalogue indoors or outdoors.
[/list][line]🧩 Compatibility[list]
[*]Single player & multiplayer (everyone needs the same content for items to appear).
[*]Works with Stardew 1.6+ and SMAPI 4.0+.
[*]Should be compatible with most mods; if another mod edits Robin’s stock on the same day, load order may affect visibility
[/list][line]📦 Modpacks & redistribution[list]
[*]You may include this mod in a modpack that links back to this page.
[*]Please don’t reupload this mod elsewhere; link here instead.
[*]Patches/add-ons are welcome; credit required.
[/list][line]🙏 Credits[list]
